Project-R is a strategic independent commercial project under the SSCCS
initiative, already in its early build phase with a portential manufacturing partner.

A large language model is stateless. Every
interaction begins from zero, so the context memory that makes it useful lives on cloud infrastructure. As governments pour
billions into sovereign models, this contextual surface, and its methodologies themselves are often overlooked. But true self-sovereignty is not about who runs the model; it is about who holds the data, and especially, how. Project-R was born from this observation.

While dozens of new
AI memory solutions launch every week, almost all are software layers, enhanched existing context infrastructure -- vector stores, graph knowledge bases, MCP
servers -- targets developers and technical professionals. Project-R aims for anyone who sits at a computer, across all ages,
and non-human actors such as autonomous agents and robots.
